Name: Taller Abigail Mod
Author: BIuebird
Description:
I like being short, I like being a small cutie pie, and it makes me happy to know that I can fix it up to be shorter or as-tall-as one of my favorite in game girls.

I personally love getting to walk around and see Abigail, not the shorty we see in the game, and it's nice, because she's about the same height as the girl farmer, factoring in her bow. It's a nice change of pace if you ask me.

[b]MAKE SURE TO BACK UP YOUR ABIGAIL FILE IF YOU DONT LIKE THIS MOD[/b]
